[[File:Dr. Atul Kumar India.JPG|thumb|Dr. Atul Kumar]]
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2019}}
'''Atul Kumar''' is a synthetic organic chemist, Professor & Chief Scientist at [[Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research|the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research]] (AcSIR)<ref>{{cite web|title=AcSIR – Academy of Scientific & Innovative Research   –  Faculty List|url=http://acsir.res.in/facultylist/|website=acsir.res.in|accessdate=24 September 2017|archive-date=17 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190417055257/http://acsir.res.in/facultylist/|url-status=dead}} Search "Atul Kumar"</ref> and Chairperson of Medicinal and Process Chemistry Division  [[Central Drug Research Institute]] (CSIR-CDRI)<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Atul Kumar|url=http://www.cdri.res.in/1369.aspx?id=1369|website=www.cdri.res.in|publisher=CDRI|accessdate=24 September 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180601113324/http://www.cdri.res.in/1369.aspx?id=1369|archive-date=1 June 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> at [[Lucknow]], India and a [[Dean (education)|Dean]] at [[National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Administrative Team|url=http://niperraebareli.edu.in/admin.html|website=niperraebareli.edu.in|publisher=National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli|accessdate=24 September 2017}}</ref>

==Academic work==
Kumar has about 24 years experience in [[drug design]], medicinal chemistry and Green Chemistry<ref name=cv>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cdriindia.org/atulkumar.htm |title=Official website at CSIR |access-date=2014-11-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141104224615/http://www.cdriindia.org/atulkumar.htm |archive-date=2014-11-04 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Dr. Kumar's major contributions are the invention of anti-[[osteoporosis]] drug candidate CDRI-99/373 (CENTHANK), which is an currently in [[phase 1 clinical trial]] and NCE anti-cancer compound CDRI-S-007-1235, is currently in Pre-clinical stage.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cdri.res.in/candidatedrug.aspx|title=CDRI {{!}} Home|last=cosmic|website=www.cdri.res.in|access-date=2017-10-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170923182721/http://cdri.res.in/candidatedrug.aspx|archive-date=23 September 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cdri.res.in/Potential_leads.aspx|title=CDRI {{!}} Home|last=cosmic|website=www.cdri.res.in|access-date=2017-10-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170923182705/http://cdri.res.in/Potential_leads.aspx|archive-date=23 September 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Chakravarti|first=Bandana|last2=Akhtar|first2=Tahseen|last3=Rai|first3=Byanju|last4=Yadav|first4=Manisha|last5=Siddiqui|first5=Jawed Akhtar|last6=Dwivedi|first6=Shailendra Kumar Dhar|last7=Thakur|first7=Ravi|last8=Singh|first8=Anup Kumar|last9=Singh|first9=Abhishek Kumar|title=Thioaryl Naphthylmethanone Oxime Ether Analogs as Novel Anticancer Agents|journal=Journal of Medicinal Chemistry|language=en|volume=57|issue=19|pages=8010–8025|doi=10.1021/jm500873e|pmid=25198997|year=2014}}</ref>
